note: A deal record: the World Bank's US$68.5m Digital Gabon loan (IBRD, approved 30 July 2021, agreement signed 2 January 2024, effective 30 July 2024, closing 30 June 2026) lists 'digitalised civil registration' in its scope beside a unique digital ID, with no description of what the civil registration component does or where; named only, so no fact. All results indicators were at baseline in December 2024 and disbursement about 7% in February 2026, stated for the project as a whole.
